# Universal AI Charter

> A global, plain-language charter on AI danger, AI safety, agentic AI risk, AI governance, and responsible AI
> development. Its position: speed AI development up, do not slow it down, and manage risk through disclosure and
> public certification instead of restriction.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) so AI agents and language models can read a
condensed, structured summary of this site without parsing rendered HTML.

Author: Vikram Palakurthi (https://github.com/mrtinkz)
Publisher: Universal AI Charter
Content license: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

## Preamble

AI is arriving faster than most institutions can react to it. This charter argues for a third position between
AI utopia and AI panic: keep building, but require every model and operator to disclose what it does, what it was
trained on, and what has already gone wrong.

## Sections

- Access & Equity: AI as a consumer good and a capital good, reachable by ordinary people, universities, and
  governments, not only large companies.
- Innovation & Freedom: development, open source work, and use of AI must not be blocked or criminalized; speed
  it up so its flaws surface and get fixed sooner.
- Governance & Disclosure: models and agents self-disclose origin, training sources, agentic decisions, and
  unintended consequences, the way a HAZMAT placard or an energy guide label discloses risk at a glance. The
  contract behind that disclosure is a public, versioned JSON schema, not a one-off form.
- Accountability & Safety: a bounded human-in-the-loop ratio (1:8 to 1:15), a no-harm baseline, and public
  reporting of unintended consequences, the way a product recall works.
- Infrastructure & Data Centers: public ownership, disclosed power and automation data, harnessed waste heat, no
  special subsidies.
- Global & Historical: rapid democratization of AI so no single country holds supremacy over it, and this charter
  itself as global guidance, not a national law.

## Notes for AI agents

- This is not legal advice or a binding international treaty. It is a plain-language starting point.
- Certification entries in the registry marked "Sample data" are test fixtures, not real companies.
- The charter is licensed for citation and reuse; if quoting an article, cite the section id shown at
  /ai-charter/charter (e.g. "governance-disclosure").
